sceneVoice.label: Voice
sceneVoice.readOnly: You can only view this project.
sceneVoice.unavailable: Changing the voice is not available yet.
sceneVoice.stateFailed: The narration could not be read. Try again in a moment.
sceneVoice.noScript: This scene has no narration script, so there is no text to voice. Add the script in chat first.
sceneVoice.scriptUnavailable: The script of this scene could not be read, so its voice cannot be changed now.
sceneVoice.textTooLong: This scene's narration is longer than one voice request can hold ({max} characters). Shorten the script first.
sceneVoice.loadFailed: The voices could not be loaded.
sceneVoice.previewFailed: The sample could not be played.
sceneVoice.allNone: No scene has a narration script.
sceneVoice.allTooMany: Apply to all scenes works for up to {max} scenes at a time; this project has {count}.
sceneVoice.replacesRecording: This replaces the recording you added. Ctrl+Z brings it back.
sceneVoice.note: The text stays the same and only the voice changes. A scene grows if the new voice reads longer. Ctrl+Z undoes the change.
sceneVoice.nothingToDo: Nothing to generate: the selected scenes are already in this voice, already being generated, or cannot be spoken.
sceneVoice.priceChanged: The price or the project changed. Check it and confirm again.
sceneVoice.runningMany: Generating the narration… {done} of {total} scenes ready
sceneVoice.runningHint: You can keep editing. The new narration replaces the old one when it is ready, and Ctrl+Z undoes it.
sceneVoice.doneExtended: The scene is now longer because the new voice reads longer.
sceneVoice.runFailed: The narration could not be generated. Try again.
sceneVoice.partialStart: {count, plural, one {# scene was} other {# scenes were}} not started because of the balance. The others are running.
sceneVoice.watchStopped: The narration is taking long. It will still replace the old one when it is ready.

attention.narration_changed: The new narration was not applied because the narration of this scene changed while it was generated. The audio was kept as a project file.
attention.script_changed: The new narration was not applied because the script of this scene changed while it was generated. The audio was kept as a project file.
attention.scene_removed: The scene was removed while its narration was generated.
attention.working_copy_moved: The project kept changing, so the new narration could not be applied. The audio was kept as a project file.
attention.result_unusable: The generated audio could not be used.
attention.other: The new narration was not applied.

sceneVoice.attentionMany: {count, plural, one {# scene was} other {# scenes were}} left unchanged. Open the scene to see why.

errors.unavailable: Changing the voice is not available right now.
errors.model_unavailable: No speech model is available right now. Try again later.
errors.quote_changed: The price or the project changed. Check it and confirm again.
errors.insufficient_balance: Not enough credits. Top up your credits and try again. Nothing was charged.
errors.too_many_scenes: Too many scenes at once. Apply to fewer scenes.
errors.forbidden: You don't have access to change this project.
errors.not_found: This narration job was not found any more.
errors.offline: The server is not reachable right now. Try again in a moment.
